fusions.name: Patient Last Stitch
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The stitch deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Among the Herd
fusions.desc: Jabs at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Warm Stitches
fusions.desc: Stitches shut the wounds of you and your allies, restoring 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Pace
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
